summary: Tested updated POST /api/pdf/to-images endpoint across all 3 modes (page_count_only, specific pages, legacy full render) plus input validation and auth guard. 7/7 pytest tests pass. All three modes behave exactly as specified; no regressions in the legacy full-render path.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1373 correctly clamps pages to doc range using `1 <= p <= total_doc_pages` and dedupes+sorts — safe against duplicates and out-of-range values.
server.py:1375 caps rendered pages at max_pages to prevent abuse (good).
page_count_only path (server.py:1367-1369) closes doc before returning — no leak.
server.py is 1823 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider modularizing PDF/image endpoints into a router module (pre-existing, not introduced by this change).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: guest user via /api/auth/guest and a locally generated 3-page PyMuPDF PDF (in-memory, not persisted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_to_images_modes.py covers all three modes of /api/pdf/to-images plus validation and auth. Uses PyMuPDF (fitz) to generate a 3-page PDF fixture in-session.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Mode-1 asserts total_pages==3 & pages==[]; Mode-2 asserts exactly [1,3] rendered with non-empty data at requested dpi/format; Mode-3 asserts all 3 pages returned sequentially. Invalid base64 → 400, missing field → 422, no auth → 401. Extra edge test: out-of-range page number in `pages` is silently filtered (verified expected behavior).
